verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State documents a sanctioned registered-agent rail: forms to appoint a new registered agent and office (docs-8, docs-10), and a separate Commercial Registered Agent registration for providers representing more than 10 companies (docs-11). It also lists an Authorized Users e-filing system for UCC filings (docs-12). The evidence is mostly form and page titles rather than in-depth guidance. missing for 10: documentation of what registered agents or other designees may file or do on the company's behalf, details of the authorized-user or CRA onboarding process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
